flows.title: Resend a receipt to a customer
steps: Go to the Transactions area in ThriveCart.
Locate the transaction you want to resend the invoice for.
Click the invoice button on the transaction. A modal window shows the customer's invoice. For a subscription, click the Manage button on the transaction first, then click View invoice.
Click the Re-send to customer button to send the invoice email to the customer again.
Receipts are resent one transaction at a time. If the customer still does not see it, ask them to check spam, trash and any inbox filters.
